import { useMemo } from 'react'; import { Footprints, Hand, Move, Pause, Sword, Trophy, Volume2, VolumeX, FlaskConical } from 'lucide-react'; import clsx from 'clsx'; import { DIFFS } from '../game/types'; import type { DiffKey } from '../game/types'; import { bat, golem, hero, slime, spriteURL } from '../game/sprites'; interface Props { diff: DiffKey; setDiff: (d: DiffKey) => void; hi: number; muted: boolean; onMute: () => void; onPlay: () => void } const CONTROLS = [ { icon: Move, k: 'Flechas / WASD', v: 'Moverse' }, { icon: Sword, k: 'Espacio / J / clic', v: 'Espada' }, { icon: Footprints, k: 'Shift / K', v: 'Esquivar' }, { icon: Hand, k: 'E / Enter', v: 'Hablar · abrir' }, { icon: FlaskConical, k: 'Q', v: 'Beber poción' }, { icon: Pause, k: 'P / Esc', v: 'Pausa' }, ]; export function Menu({ diff, setDiff, hi, muted, onMute, onPlay }: Props) { const art = useMemo(() => ({ hero: spriteURL(hero(0, 0, false), 6), slime: spriteURL(slime('slime', 0), 4), bat: spriteURL(bat(0), 4), boss: spriteURL(golem(0, false), 3) }), []); return (
